summary: neat-freak sync for Phase 3 (outbound providers: T13 registry, T14 notifications, T12 messages, T22 code adapters, T23 the 16 declarative spec adapters, T24 bell/desktop local adapters, T29 importer), bundled with the still-uncommitted Phase 2 entity services. Product docs were moved to reflect implemented-vs-planned: v1/CHANGELOG/HANDOFF/PROGRESS and docs/architecture|integration-guide|runbook now state that the domain/storage/security foundation, the Phase 2 entity services and the Phase 3 outbound layer are implemented and tested, while host/dsh, inbound services, runtime, rpc, cli and ui remain unimplemented design targets. The v0 adapter contract doc (v1/docs/adapter-reference.md) is deleted because it documented pre-rewrite paths (src/config.mjs, src/adapters/spec-channels.mjs, _engine.mjs, NotifyError) that no longer exist; its role is superseded by the frozen docs/developer/v1-flash-v3/04-PROVIDERS.md contract. Verified with npm run test:unit, npm run test:protocol and npm run test:integration (233 tests) plus npm run check.
